hooks.command: d=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "${d%/.git}/tools/hooks/identity.py" ] || { echo '{"systemMessage": "The identity hook did not run: no tools/hooks/identity.py was found in the main checkout of the project folder."}'; exit 0; }; python3 -I "${d%/.git}/tools/hooks/identity.py" || exit 2
